# CHIPBLASTER

> A free Commodore 64 music player in the browser. It browses and plays the High Voltage SID Collection (HVSC #85, about 61,000 SID tunes) through a 1980s hi-fi styled player, with a VIC-II style CRT visualizer. No install or account; it runs entirely in the browser.

- Site: https://chipblaster.sulopuis.to/
- Source code (GPL-2.0-or-later): https://github.com/ollisulopuisto/chipblaster

## What it does

- Search the HVSC catalogue by tune name, composer or path; build a queue and a playlist; save favourite tunes.
- Plays PSID files with a SID emulator; switch SID 1 between the 6581 and 8580 chips, plays multi-SID tunes.
- Infinite play draws random tunes from the search results, favourites or an open folder, and ends looping tunes on a loop boundary with a fade.
- Level matching, bass/mid/treble tone controls and a stereo widener.
- A CRT visualizer with effects modelled on well-known C64 demos, driven by the SID voices.
- Links can name a tune and a visual effect, so a tune can be shared.

## Optional

- README: https://github.com/ollisulopuisto/chipblaster/blob/main/README.md
- High Voltage SID Collection: https://www.hvsc.c64.org/
